notes: Dart T2 with Dart 3.14.1 in Docker (image pinned by digest; override with BGRAPH_DART_IMAGE). One long-lived container per repo with the checkout at /repo and the pub cache in the named volume bgraph-dart-t2-pubcache; `dart pub get` runs once per package, then every run is `dart test --reporter json` in each listed package, the packages concurrently. Two whole-suite baselines at R give the suite census (the provider cross-check) and the tests already red or flaky there (excluded per test). Every mutant runs the whole suite of every listed package; red suites are confirmed by re-running their packages; a load failure with a compile error marks the mutant nocompile. Tries is the fixed number of sampled one-token mutations per repository, split evenly over the listed packages. dart-lang/core is a multi-package repository without a pub workspace (independent pubspecs, no path dependencies); its listed packages are the ones outside package:test's own dependency closure: in a package's directory pub resolves every package:<name> to the root package, so mutating args, async, collection, convert, crypto, logging, path or typed_data also mutates the test runner (a crashing or non-compiling `dart test`), which is a runner artefact rather than a test verdict. invertase/melos is a pub workspace whose melos package depends on its conventional_commit member.
